summary: Serve MiMo V2 decode and speculative verify through b12x paged_decode
details: The B12X backend serves DiffKV layers and non-causal FP8-KV drafter layers through b12x paged_decode, including ragged adaptive-verification batches, and appends their KV through the same plan.
Other layer geometries keep their existing B12X paths (VLLM_B12X_PAGED_DECODE=auto).
